Security, by design Safe, private, and trusted with client data. Tax work is sensitive. Tallia is engineered to ensure that everything you put into the platform is confidential and protected at every layer. Explore our security Zero training on your data Your inputs, outputs, and uploads are never used to train models. Data residency & control You control what is uploaded, how long it is retained, and when it is deleted. Access that matches your IdP Single sign-on, role-based access, and a full audit log of every query and draft. Encrypted, end to end TLS 1.3 in transit. AES-256 at rest. Logically separated workspaces. Clarity, from the start. A closer look at working with Tallia, and how we treat the information you entrust to us. Talk to our team What can I expect from a demo? A 30-minute walkthrough with our team, where we share how other firms are changing their practice with Tallia. Book a Demo What counts as my data? Two things: the documents you upload, and the questions and answers that pass through the platform. Both are treated as confidential customer data and protected the same way. Do you train models on my data? No. We contractually prohibit training, fine-tuning, or model improvement on your inputs, outputs, or documents - including by our model providers, who operate under zero-data-retention terms. How is my data protected? Tallia is ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 Type II audited, both assessed independently. Behind that: encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256), role-based access on a least-privilege basis, logical separation between every customer, and continuous monitoring across infrastructure and application. Who controls access to my data? Access follows least privilege and is gated by SSO/SAML, enforced MFA, and role-based permissions you manage. Every query and draft is captured in an audit log you can stream to your SIEM. What happens to my data if we leave? You can delete data at any time, and on offboarding everything is hard-deleted within 30 days. See what Tallia can do for your team. Working with Tallia Data & security Working with Tallia. What can I expect from a demo? A 30-minute walkthrough with our team, where we share how other firms are changing their practice with Tallia. What does a pilot involve? A small group of fee earners use Tallia on real client work, with our team supporting onboarding, prompt frameworks, and integration into your knowledge sources. We agree success metrics up front. Where can I explore the platform? Research, Draft, Review, and Projects bring research, drafting, document comparison, and shared engagement work into one platform. Explore each through the Platform menu. Your data. Your control. What counts as my data? Two things: the documents you upload, and the questions and answers that pass through the platform. Both are treated as confidential customer data and protected the same way. Do you train models on my data? No. We contractually prohibit training, fine-tuning, or model improvement on your inputs, outputs, or documents - including by our model providers, who operate under zero-data-retention terms. How is my data protected? Encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256), role-based access on a least-privilege basis, logical separation between every customer, and continuous monitoring across infrastructure and application. Where is my data stored? In secure, ISO-aligned cloud infrastructure kept in-region. You control retention policies, and data is hard-deleted within 30 days of offboarding. Who can access my data, and how is that controlled? Access follows least privilege and is gated by SSO/SAML, enforced MFA, and role-based permissions you manage. Every query and draft is captured in an audit log you can stream to your SIEM. How often is security tested? Automated vulnerability scanning runs continuously, alongside independent third-party penetration testing and ongoing monitoring. Tallia is ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 Type II audited, both assessed independently. What happens to my data if we leave? You can delete data at any time, and on offboarding everything is hard-deleted within 30 days. A closer look Still have a question?
